summary: Iteration 110: Module Fields Endpoint & Binding Variable Feature Testing. All 17 backend tests passed (100%), 1 skipped (known bug). The new GET /api/business-tools/panels/module-fields/{module_id} endpoint works correctly for all 8 system modules and custom panels. Auto-created relation fields have systemManaged:true. CRITICAL BUG: bindingField is NOT stored in backend - Pydantic model missing the field.

critical.issue: bindingField is NOT stored in relation fields. The Pydantic model PanelFieldInput (line 33-42 in panel_router.py) does not include 'bindingField: Optional[str] = None'. Frontend sends it but backend strips it.
critical.fix: Add 'bindingField: Optional[str] = None' to PanelFieldInput and AddFieldRequest models in panel_router.py

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend implementation is correct. The binding variable dropdown appears after selecting a target, auto-sets field label, and sends bindingField to backend. However, backend doesn't store it.

bug_details.title: bindingField not stored in relation fields
bug_details.description: When creating a panel with a relation field that includes bindingField, the backend strips it because the Pydantic models don't include this field.
reproduction_steps: 1. Create a panel with a relation field including bindingField: 'productName'
2. Check the response - bindingField is missing from the field definition
3. The frontend sends bindingField but backend ignores it
bug_details.root_cause: PanelFieldInput (line 33-42) and AddFieldRequest (line 64-72) in panel_router.py don't include 'bindingField: Optional[str] = None'
bug_details.fix: Add 'bindingField: Optional[str] = None' to both Pydantic models
